variant_X_contamination_mechanism.observation: x3 has the SAME scalar ISSUE-equivalent as prod (132.50 vs 132.84) yet aic_scalar_time = 953.43 = 100.0% of aic_time 953.48, with aic_scalar_mte1_stall 867.90 (+334.03) and aic_scalar_cube_stall 78.00 (+77.79, from 0.20); AIV wait_ib 2.01 -> 20.75.
variant_X_contamination_mechanism.mechanism: CrossCoreSetFlag<mode,PIPE> is a scalar instruction that BLOCKS until PIPE drains. In production the paired CrossCoreWaitFlag keeps the pipe shallow, so each set's drain is nearly free. Delete the waits and keep the sets, and every set becomes a full-pipe-drain blocking point that production never had; the block is attributed to the drained pipe (mte1/cube) and to wait_ib.
variant_X_contamination_mechanism.conclusion: variant X is NOT a pure-latency probe. It is 'latency removed + a NEW drain cost added', and the added cost dominates (+218.80 us over variant Y at L3 case9, p=0.0001). Variant Y is the only clean construction.
